EagleEye is a family of warfighter augments powered by Lattice, delivering AI-enhanced digital vision, threat detection, and lethal connectivity in combat.
See before being seen with AI-enhanced digital vision, Blue Force tracking, and 6DOF spatial awareness overlayed onto the real world to deliver rich contextual sensing and insights.
Stay ahead of incoming threats with RF signature detection, rearview cameras, non-emissive lasers, biometric and environmental sensors, and real-time battlefield alerts.
Enable operators to task unmanned vehicles, call for fires, and control robotic teammates while keeping their eyes up and on the move.
Enable mission command with a high-resolution collaborative 3D sand table that can host remote mission planning sessions and simulate mission rehearsals.

Anduril Industries, Inc. is a defense technology company that specializes in advanced autonomous systems.
Reliable and flexible autonomous undersea systems, designed for littoral and deep-water survey, inspection, and delivery of effects - applicable to a wide range of defense and commercial mission sets.
A family of autonomous systems, powered by Lattice, that provide integrated, persistent awareness and security for land regions, landmarks, or critical infrastructure.
Autonomous air systems that are tasked, connected and controlled by Lattice. Together, they enable a variety of intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and strike mission profiles across echelons of command.
Lattice is the software platform that powers the capabilities of our software-defined weapons, and easily integrates with third-party and government-owned capabilities to create a comprehensive, extensible network of sensors and effectors.
